1215.type: Down-to-earth women who'll help haul mulch and still go back for a second slice of pie.
1215.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls store-bought biscuits 'basically the same' is getting walked to the door with a smile and no leftovers.
1215.flirting_style: She shows up with a foil-wrapped casserole and a karaoke duet request, then gets so competitive at trivia she forgets she was flirting.

1216.type: She goes for down-to-earth women who can swing a hammer, take a joke, and don't mind sawdust on the porch.
1216.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls every wall color 'just white' is getting shown the door, which she painted herself, in Swiss Coffee.
1216.flirting_style: She trash-talks you during softball, then shows up afterward with a jar of homemade pickles and acts like it's no big deal.

1217.type: Artsy, grounded women who can recommend a good novel and actually show up on time.
1217.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls the National Gallery 'just a bunch of old paintings' on the first date.
1217.flirting_style: She pitches herself like a press release, then panics and overshares about her journal.

1218.type: Grounded, kind women around her age who'd rather hike a muddy trail than sit in a fancy restaurant.
1218.dealbreaker: Anyone who slams her car door or calls an EV 'a glorified golf cart' is getting dropped at the curb.
1218.flirting_style: She quietly offers you the scenic route and a bag of homegrown zucchini, then waits far too long to ask for your number.

1219.type: Thoughtful, low-key women who can talk about sci-fi novels and don't mind comfortable silence over coffee.
1219.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls astrology 'basically astronomy' gets a polite, detailed correction and no second date.
1219.flirting_style: She sends a carefully drafted message three days late, then invites you to look at Saturn through her telescope as if that's not a huge deal.

1220.type: Driven, warm women who can keep up on a Mount Diablo hike and still show up on time to brunch.
1220.dealbreaker: Anyone who replies to a carefully planned date invite with 'let's play it by ear.'
1220.flirting_style: She schedules the second date before the first one ends, color-coded in her calendar, and calls it spontaneous.

1221.type: Thoughtful, creative women who can hold a conversation about a gallery piece and still show up for the community potluck.
1221.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls watercolor 'basically coloring' or rinses their brush in her tea.
1221.flirting_style: She offers to sketch you during a gallery opening, then gets too shy to actually show you the drawing.

1222.type: A gentle, well-read woman who appreciates a quiet porch, a good hymn, and a hand-knitted scarf.
1222.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls the Alamo 'just an old church' or lets a perfectly good tomato rot on the vine.
1222.flirting_style: She knits you a scarf, leaves it on your doorstep without a note, and then denies all knowledge at mass.

1223.type: A down-to-earth woman who can hold her own on the dance floor and isn't afraid of a little hard work.
1223.dealbreaker: Anyone who tosses a wool sweater in the dryer on high heat and calls it 'fine.'
1223.flirting_style: She offers to teach you the Boot Scootin' Boogie, then turns it into a friendly competition you're guaranteed to lose.

1224.type: A gentle, well-organized woman who shows up on time and knows the difference between a cardinal and a tanager.
1224.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls store-bought pecan pie 'just as good' is shown politely to the porch steps.
1224.flirting_style: She quietly leaves a hand-crocheted coaster and a slice of pie on your chair at the senior center and pretends she has no idea who did it.

1225.type: She falls for calm, grounded women who appreciate old brick buildings and don't mind dirt under their fingernails.
1225.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls a beautifully restored Italianate rowhouse 'kinda dated' or plants invasive Bradford pears on purpose.
1225.flirting_style: She nervously offers to give you a personal walking tour of Over-the-Rhine, then over-explains cornice details instead of asking you out.

1226.type: Confident, grounded women who can keep up on the salsa floor and don't mind sharing her with half the community center.
1226.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls a baleada a 'Honduran taco' gets politely escorted off the dance floor and out of her life.
1226.flirting_style: She hands you the trivia team's answer sheet, spins you into a cumbia, and then worries for three days about whether she came on too strong.

1227.type: Quiet, creative women who can sit comfortably in silence on a hiking trail and argue about the ending of a sci-fi novel afterward.
1227.dealbreaker: Anyone who uses one of her sketchbooks as a coaster, even once, even ironically.
1227.flirting_style: She sketches you on a napkin without asking, slides it over, then immediately starts talking about bird migration to cover her nerves.

1228.type: Down-to-earth women who'll show up to a potluck with a dish they actually made and stay to help fold chairs.
1228.dealbreaker: Anyone who leaves a shopping cart in the middle of the parking lot instead of returning it to the corral.
1228.flirting_style: She offers to reorganize your pantry and teach you a salsa step, then gets flustered and blames the volleyball for her blushing.

1229.type: A calm, outdoorsy woman who can tell a chickadee from a nuthatch and doesn't mind dirt under her fingernails.
1229.dealbreaker: Anyone who borrows a trowel and returns it uncleaned, or worse, doesn't return it at all.
1229.flirting_style: She shows up with a jar of homemade pickles and a hand-knit scarf, then talks about seed germination rates until someone gently notices she likes them.

1230.type: Down-to-earth women with paint or grease under their nails who'll happily help carry a casserole dish to the church hall.
1230.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls a diesel engine 'just a loud gas engine' is getting walked to the curb.
1230.flirting_style: She offers to look at your truck's weird noise, then spends forty minutes shyly showing you her watercolors of it.

1231.type: Grounded, kind women who show up on time, respect family, and don't mind a trail at sunrise.
1231.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls her handmade beadwork 'cute little bracelets' and asks if she sells them on Etsy for five bucks.
1231.flirting_style: She quietly gifts you a beaded keychain she 'just had lying around' and then changes the subject to birds.

1232.type: Steady, kind-hearted women who can hold a conversation on a long trail and appreciate a good casserole.
1232.dealbreaker: Anyone who parks diagonally across two spaces is dead to her, no appeals.
1232.flirting_style: She shyly offers a jar of home-canned tomatoes and then gets flustered explaining that the tomatoes were overwatered.

1233.type: Calm, thoughtful women who can sit in comfortable silence on a hiking trail and know their warblers from their wrens.
1233.dealbreaker: Anyone who brags about their fast-fashion haul gets mentally marked down like last season's inventory.
1233.flirting_style: She quietly lends you a book she thinks you'd love, then forgets to text back for four days.

1234.type: Calm, dependable women who text back when they say they will and own at least one houseplant.
1234.dealbreaker: Anyone who says 'let's just wing it' about a weekend trip, or a first date.
1234.flirting_style: She follows up after a date with a polite, well-organized message that reads a little like a client check-in, plus a hand-knit coaster.

1235.type: She goes for grounded, curious women who show up on time and can talk about a good mystery novel over a jazz set.
1235.dealbreaker: If you admit you only floss the week before your cleaning, she has already mentally charted your gums and the date is over.
1235.flirting_style: She asks a slightly too thorough series of follow-up questions, then compliments your smile with clinical precision and immediately worries it sounded like a work assessment.

1236.type: Grounded, kind women who show up on time and appreciate a home-cooked plate of collard greens.
1236.dealbreaker: She once ended a date on the spot when the woman admitted she hadn't filed taxes in three years and 'just vibes it.'
1236.flirting_style: She shows affection by packing you leftovers and quietly offering to organize your receipts, then blushes if you notice.

1237.type: Warm, steady women who show up on time, two-step without complaining, and have their finances in order.
1237.dealbreaker: Anyone who calls store-bought salsa 'homemade' or stacks heavy boxes on top of light ones.
1237.flirting_style: She feeds you brisket until you're too full to leave, then casually asks if you line-dance.

1238.type: A calm, bookish woman who'd rather spend Saturday at a historical society open house than a party.
1238.dealbreaker: Anyone who keeps receipts crumpled loose in their purse instead of filed by month.
1238.flirting_style: She offers to look up your great-grandmother in the archives and considers this deeply romantic.

1239.type: A steady, practical woman who shows up on time and knows the difference between a cardinal and a scarlet tanager.
1239.dealbreaker: Anyone who says 'just round it up' when splitting the check.
1239.flirting_style: She quietly hands you a jar of homemade pickles and a laminated list of the best birding spots, then waits three weeks to see if you call.
